source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U08: Separate omitted penalty provisions from criminal offence and cognizance rules

facts.statement: Book expressly identifies former section27/28 fine rules as omitted in2016. Section29 contravention/attempt/abetment up to1year or fine/both. Section30 written authorised complaint and specified Magistrate rank.

payload.title: Identify the provision in force before choosing a penalty
payload.core_explanation_md:
The book discusses earlier daily-default and RBI-direction fine provisions but expressly marks them as omitted by the 2016 amendments. They belong in the history of the law, not an unqualified current penalty calculator. Section29 separately addresses contravention, attempts and abetment with its stated imprisonment/fine alternatives.

Cognizance under section30 is also a distinct gate: the required written complaint and authorised officer matter, as does the specified Magistrate jurisdiction. An alleged breach, an administrative penalty and a criminal conviction are different events. Record the allegation, authority, applicable version and process rather than converting every compliance finding into an automatic criminal sentence.

self_check.prompt_text: Can an omitted daily fine be applied merely because it appears in an older chapter?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Check the applicable provision and amendment status.

payload.stem_md: A compliance sheet applies the former section28 fine without mentioning that the source marks the provision omitted. What correction is required?

options.text_md: Apply both old and new penalties automatically
options.explanation_md: Repealed or omitted provisions cannot simply be accumulated.

options.text_md: Separate historical text from the applicable offence/penalty route
options.explanation_md: The version and operative provision determine the legal analysis.

options.text_md: Convert every alleged breach directly into imprisonment
options.explanation_md: An allegation is not a conviction and the process matters.

options.text_md: Treat an RBI information request as a court sentence
options.explanation_md: A supervisory request and criminal adjudication are different.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The version and operative provision determine the legal analysis.

payload.stem_md: A criminal intake note records only an informal accusation and omits the written authorised-complaint requirement. Which section30 issue is missing?

options.explanation_md: Pricing does not establish the statutory cognizance gate.
Insurance is not the prescribed complaint authority.

options.text_md: A rule that any private email is always an authorised statutory complaint
options.explanation_md: The complainant authority and written authorisation must be established.

options.text_md: Whether cognizance is supported by the required complaint and competent forum
options.explanation_md: The procedural gate must be checked separately from the allegation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The procedural gate must be checked separately from the allegation.
